definition: Tanagra is a free suite of machine learning software for research and academic purposes developed by Ricco Rakotomalala at the Lumière University Lyon 2, France.
details: Tanagra supports several standard data mining tasks such as: Visualization, Descriptive statistics, Instance selection, feature selection, feature construction, regression, factor analysis, clustering, classification and association rule learning. Tanagra is an academic project. It is widely used in French-speaking universities. Tanagra is frequently used in real studies and in software comparison papers.

explainer.lead: Tanagra is a free machine learning software suite for research and academic purposes, developed by Ricco Rakotomalala at Lumière University Lyon 2. It matters as a widely used academic tool in French-speaking universities and in software comparison studies.
